final: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall_average_rate FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId)), qualifying AS (SELECT COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS average_rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId HAVING AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) > (SELECT overall_average_rate FROM overall)) SELECT AVG(average_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(track_count) AS average_number_of_tracks, AVG(average_rate - (SELECT overall_average_rate FROM overall)) AS average_margin_above_overall_average FROM qualifying
